evidence_items.explanation: The study examines an LLM-based assistant in actual customer-support work, with rollout extending into winter 2021. The estimated gain is material under the ordinary workplace reading, although it is not an economy-wide estimate.
This randomized study supplies material counterevidence to any suggestion that gains are universal. A slowdown in this setting does not establish the absence of meaningful gains elsewhere.
